abstract: Choriocarcinoma can be cured by chemotherapy, but this causes resistance and severe side effects that bring about physical and psychological consequences for patients. Therefore, there is still an urgent need to find other alternative minimally invasive therapies to halt the progression of choriocarcinoma. Novel carbon-coated selenium nanoparticles (C-Se) were successfully synthesized for choriocarcinoma photothermal therapy. C-Se combined with near-infrared laser irradiation can inhibit the proliferation of human choriocarcinoma (JEG-3) cells and induce cell apoptosis. C-Se killed cells and produced ROS under near-infrared laser irradiation. Finally, the therapeutic mechanism of C-Se + laser was explored showing that C-Se + laser influenced numerous biological processes. Taken together, C-Se exhibited significant potential for choriocarcinoma photothermal therapy.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は化学療法で治癒可能であるが、これは耐性と患者に身体的・心理的影響をもたらす重篤な副作用を引き起こす。したがって、絨毛癌の進行を停止させるための他の代替最小侵襲療法を見つけることがまだ急務である。新規炭素被覆セレニウムナノ粒子(C-Se)は絨毛癌光熱療法のために正常に合成された。C-Seを近赤外線レーザー照射と組み合わせるとヒト絨毛癌(JEG-3)細胞の増殖を阻害し、細胞アポトーシスを誘導することができた。C-Seは近赤外線レーザー照射下で細胞を殺傷し、ROS を産生した。最後に、C-Se +レーザー療法のメカニズムを探索し、C-Se +レーザーが多数の生物学的プロセスに影響を与えることを示した。総合すると、C-Seは絨毛癌光熱療法に有意な可能性を示した。
